title: Several collected lore/evidence items (curling survey map, cipher notes, causeway-stone/mere's-answer evidence for the Kings' Rest name-puzzle) were flagged as relevant to quests but never had a clear action to actually consume them before the run ended, leaving it unclear if they were needed.
